hard_fail_reasons: Clockwork role readability remains 4/5 in the fixed 12-inch four-facing production stills; the role does not yet meet the user's requirement that the worker identity be visually dominant at gameplay distance.
No candidate-specific isolated 50-citizen performance result exists. The render receipts vary from 2 to 40 FPS across views and are not suitable for an acceptance claim.
incumbent_comparison: v089 preserves the MPFB anatomical body and rig and improves the broad workwear silhouette over v087 through a flared, two-panel machinist overcoat and shoulder yoke. It is a substantial improvement over the block-built citizen-v007, but the Clockwork role is not yet visually dominant at the fixed gameplay view and the twin optics do not resolve consistently at 12 inches. Keep citizen-v007 as the production incumbent; v089 remains a best-current review challenger.
likely_causes: A half-inch citizen occupies roughly 40 pixels at the 12-inch capture distance, leaving few pixels for helmet optics and role-specific garment structure.
The broad skirt improves the lower outline, but the strongest distinctive Clockwork cues remain concentrated at the head and back rather than forming a dominant full-body silhouette.
The independently attached production tool must stay visible and overlaps the central torso; surrounding clothing must carry the role read around that fixed occlusion.
No controlled candidate-specific performance session was captured.
next_action_hypothesis: Do not iterate the skirt width, hem binding, or helmet LOD again. Keep the MPFB body/rig if it remains the best anatomical foundation; check a character-appropriate generation path only if it can be rigged to the preserved skeleton.
